recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. If a future work group wants a standard way to mark partial withholding within populated lists, handle that as a new substantive design issue rather than changing the existing List.emptyReason semantics.
issue_request: FHIR-8150 was a Published FHIR-core/List change request from the 2015 May DAF ballot, resolved Not Persuasive with Modification. It asked whether the List.emptyReason code for information withheld could convey partial withholding on a non-empty list; the approved disposition was to clarify that the empty reason applies when all list content has been withheld, while partial population has no known general solution other than notes or entry-level flags.
initial_application: Git-svn commit 41329eb70f2b855bd911c8fdcf95b521332faefd, svn revision 6085, applied the issue as '#8150 - clarify use of List.emptyReason'. It updated the List spreadsheet comment to say the code is for the entire list being suppressed rather than individual items being omitted, and changed the withheld code definition to say the content of the list was not provided. Later source refactoring carried that wording into source/list/structuredefinition-List.xml.
additional_context: List is active in source/fhir.ini. Current source/list/structuredefinition-List.xml has constraint lst-1 requiring emptyReason only when entry is empty, and the List.emptyReason comment still says it is for the entire list being suppressed, not individual omitted items. source/list/list-notes.xml separately warns receivers not to assume a list is complete because some entries may have been withheld. The current THO CodeSystem-list-empty-reason definition for list-empty-reason#withheld also retains the 'content of the list was not provided' wording. Related Jira/Zulip/Confluence searches found no final conflicting decision.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The active core source and moved terminology surface already express the approved FHIR-8150 clarification and do not imply that List.emptyReason reports partial withholding on non-empty lists.
